1 notice dated 27.06.2024 issued by the respondent-Himachal Pradesh Public Works Department ('HPPWD').

The notice states that:- petitioner's structure/land had been acquired by the Department for construction of Slapper Tattapani Road km 0/00 to 68/00 at RD 35/360; The compensation amount was finalized and paid to the petitioner in September 2022; Mutation was also entered and attested on 22.02.2023; The petitioner has not evacuated the existing structure over the land, which had been duly acquired for the construction of the road.
Because of this act, the construction work has been hampered, causing an enhancement in construction cost.
In terms of the notice, the petitioner was directed to evacuate the structure from the acquired land by the HPPWD, failing which the Department was to take appropriate action in accordance with law.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that:-
3(i).

The State of Himachal Pradesh had issued a notification on 04.06.2019 expressing interest in acquiring .
the petitioner's land/structure for the construction of road from Slapper to Tattapani.
The award was passed on 10.06.2022.
However, the petitioner was neither associated with the acquisition proceedings nor objections were invited from him.

The petitioner became aware of the acquisition process upon receipt of a notice under Section 37(2)
of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for brevity 'the Act').
3(ii).

sentences.text: Respondents No.3 and 4, although have passed the award for acquisition of the petitioner's land but the structure over the said land has not been acquired.
Despite representing to the respondents, no compensation has been paid to the petitioner for the structure existing over the acquired land.
Hence, the impugned notice dated 27.06.2024, directing the petitioner to evacuate the existing structure, is not in consonance with the law.
The respondents are duty bound by law to pay compensation for the structure existing over the acquired land.

4. The stand of the respondents is that:-
4(i) Slapper to Tattapani Road is being .
upgraded/constructed by the HPPWD in order to make it an intermediate lane road.
Land of the petitioner falls along with Khasra No.271 at KM 35/700 of road.
Petitioner's land has been acquired by the HPPWD and Award No.11/2022 had been passed by the Land Acquisition Collector on 10.06.2022.
First notification under Section 11 of the Act, was issued by the State of Himachal Pradesh on 04.06.2019.
It was published in 'Rajpatra' on 10.06.2019 and also in two daily newspapers on 11.06.2019 and 12.06.2019.

sentences.text: During the process of finalizing notification under Section 11 of the Act, the Land Acquisition Collector had prepared a report "Faihrist Makanat Zeramda Sadak".
This report gave the details of the public property, structures, temples and step wells etc. existing at the relevant time over the land in question.
The report mentioned the position of existing structures over the acquired land at the time of issuing notification under Section 11 of the Act.
As per this report, there was no structure/house/building on the land in question.
The structure alleged by the petitioner in existence over the acquired land was not there at the time of issuance of notification under Section 11.

The petitioner with an ill .
intent to grab compensation from the respondents
has constructed the structure on the acquired land.
The construction has been carried out by the petitioner after the issuance of notification under Section 11 of the Act.
Therefore, the contention of the respondents is that they are acquired land.
r to not liable to pay any compensation for the structure over the 5.

Having considered the respective contentions of the parties, it comes out that according to the respondents, the land of the petitioner falling within the alignment of Slapper-Tattapani Road had been duly acquired in accordance with law and compensation thereof, had been duly paid to the petitioner.

The structure, which the petitioner alleges not to have been acquired by the respondents and which according to the petitioner had not been compensated for in accordance with law, was not found on the land in question at the time of issuance of notification under Section 11 of the Act.
According to the respondents, the structure in question was raised by the petitioner over the acquired land subsequent to 12.06.2019, i.e. issuance of notification under Section 11 of the Act.

No evidence to the .
contrary has been produced on record by the petitioner.

In view of the stand taken by the respondents in their reply, the relief prayed for by the petitioner cannot be allowed in this petition in exercise of jurisdiction under Article 226 of Constitution of India.
This petition, therefore, lacks merit and is dismissed.
